concerns.text: Task T012 is tagged `[FR-004]` but only performs GWAS logistic regression; it does **not** apply the Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction required by FR‑004. Tagging it as satisfying FR‑004 weakens the functional requirement.
Task T014 is also tagged `[FR-004]` yet only performs the FDR correction; it does **not** run the GWAS logistic regression step required by FR‑004. This split tagging weakens the requirement.

The constitution (Principle II – Verified Accuracy) mandates a Reference‑Validator step for all external citations. No task in the list implements or invokes such a validator, violating the non‑negotiable accuracy gate.

Task T018 (Phenotype‑permutation null distribution) involves stochastic permutations but does not pin a random seed, breaching Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires all stochastic processes to have deterministic seeds.
While T017 pins a random seed for LASSO CV, other stochastic scripts (e.g., T018) lack seed pinning, resulting in incomplete compliance with the reproducibility requirement.
